title: 野生眉怎么选：从基础与风格出发
title_en: Choosing a brow method for your starting point
intro: 项目是完成设计的工具。先把原生眉、面部比例与个人风格看清楚，再讨论采用哪一种做法。
intro_en: A service is a way to carry out a design. Start with the existing brows, facial proportions and personal preferences before choosing the method.

sections.title: 框架比较完整
sections.description: 讨论眉头、眉峰、眉尾和轮廓是否需要调整，是否只需少量补充毛流。手工或单仪器都有可能成为讨论方向，不凭照片直接下结论。
sections.description_en: Discuss whether the start, arch, tail or outline needs refining, and how much hair-like detail is needed. Manual or single-instrument approaches may be considered, but a photograph alone is not enough to decide.

sections.title: 结构与层次需要一起考虑
sections.title_en: Structure and layers both need attention
sections.description: 缺眉尾、局部断眉或整体稀疏时，把结构与密度分开看。适合组合线条时，用主线建立框架、绒毛线补充层次，不追求统一浓度。
sections.description_en: For missing tails, gaps or overall sparsity, assess framework and density separately. Where a combination is suitable, main strokes establish structure and fine strokes add layers. Uniform darkness is not the aim.

sections.title: 风格没有固定答案
sections.title_en: There is no single house shape
sections.description: 乐乐偏爱自然柔和，但也会根据顾客希望呈现的气质讨论利落、清晰或更有存在感的轮廓。到店设计免费，约30–45分钟，确认适合再决定。
sections.description_en: Lele favours a natural, soft appearance personally, but can discuss sharper, clearer or more expressive contours according to the client’s brief. The free design consultation takes about 30–45 minutes; decide after seeing the proposed shape.
